beats: 1. HOOK / OUTRAGE: The POV text is on screen. The creator says they are unemployed or a student and just got rejected for a simple job (summer job at EDEKA / cashier). They add 'nothing against the job, but' they have top qualifications (1.3 Abitur / bac+5), and they can't believe it.

2. THE REVEAL: They asked a friend who used to work in HR. She said their CV is probably not getting through the ATS filters. That fits: the rejections come about 5 minutes after applying. 'I thought, no way, they didn't even see my CV. And yes, they really didn't.'
3. PRODUCT INTRO: 'So here I'm uploading my CV to Parakeet AI, the site she recommended.' It analyses the CV and gives a score. Theirs isn't great because it's a Canva CV with lots of icons.

4. THE FIX: Parakeet AI rewrites and restructures it very quickly and asks questions in the chat. The creator picks a clean template. They paste the job ad so the CV is tailored to it, which gives a better chance of being shortlisted.

5. RESULT: They chat with the AI and it suggests improvements. The final score is much higher (only the number the app actually shows). The CV is clean and complete, with all the information optimised. A short wrap-up: 'so yeah'.

Beats 3–5 are a screen recording of Parakeet AI's Resume Maker with continuous voiceover (the face can stay as a small corner insert or be cut). Demo sequence: (1) upload the CV, (2) the analysis and a low score appear, (3) the AI rewrites the CV and asks questions in the chat while the creator answers, (4) pick a template, (5) paste the job ad link or text so the CV is tailored, (6) the higher score and the finished CV are shown, optionally with the download. Keep the cuts fast and the tone casual, venting, then relieved.

X08.premise: A creator with strong qualifications gets rejected for a low-barrier job. They vent about it and then learn from a friend who worked in HR that their CV probably never reached a human, because it failed the automated (ATS) filters. That explains the rejections that arrive minutes after applying. The friend recommended Parakeet AI. The creator uploads their CV, gets a weak score (a Canva CV with lots of icons), and the AI rewrites and tailors it through a short chat. The final CV scores much higher, has clean formatting and contains all the information, now optimised.
